message.text:
**Checking rate limits**

I want to inspect the rate limit for whatever I'm working on. It's important to understand how many requests I can make in a certain timeframe without hitting a wall. If I don’t keep an eye on this, I might end up getting blocked, which would slow things down. I'll be cautious about how I approach this and make sure I stay within the set limits to avoid issues. Let's see what I find!

args.command: find server cmd internal -type f -name '*.go' -not -path '*/test/*' -print0 | xargs -0 grep -n -i -E 'rate.?limit|rate limit|limiter|requests per|burst|middleware'

The server registers recovery/CORS middleware (`server/server.go:50-52`) and API authentication middleware (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:67-99`); the only rate-limit references are an unimplemented email design note (`internal/email/README.md:286-295`).
